description: This file defines the JSHandleDispatcher class, which manages JavaScript handle objects within the Playwright framework, including methods for evaluating expressions, retrieving properties, serializing, and disposing handles.

classes.name: JSHandleDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing JavaScript handle objects, supporting evaluation, property access, serialization, and disposal.

methods.name: fromJSHandle
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a JSHandleDispatcher instance from a JSHandle object within a given scope.

methods.name: evaluateExpression
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript expression in the context of the handle.

methods.name: evaluateExpressionHandle
methods.description: Evaluates an expression that returns a handle.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property handle by name.

methods.name: getPropertyList
methods.description: Retrieves all properties as a list of name-value pairs.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Serializes the handle's value to JSON.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the handle and potentially closes the scope.
